# Prochess Academy

Nigeria's premier chess academy. FIDE Infinite Chess Project partner.

## About
Prochess Academy provides structured chess education from beginner to master level. We offer courses, tournaments, puzzles, and live broadcasts through our partnership with ChessStream Africa.

## Features
- Structured chess courses (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced)
- Daily puzzles with interactive chessboard
- Tournament registration and management
- Player directory with FIDE profiles
- Summer camp programs
- Live broadcasts via ChessStream Africa

## Location
38 Ifelodun Street, Orogun, Ibadan, Nigeria
